The table lists every atom of one conventional cell (cell parameters in the first line of the table) of corundum (Al2O3, COD 9007496) as fractional coordinates. Use the kinematic structure factor F(hkl) = Σ_j Z_j exp[2πi(h x_j + k y_j + l z_j)] with atomic numbers as angle-independent weights (Al = 13, O = 8). Exactly one of the four reflections below has |F| = 0. Which one?

选项：
A. (2 1 1)
B. (0 2 0)
C. (1 1 0)
D. (0 1 2)
